newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon trade deficit $4.7 billion in nine months.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon trade deficit $4.7 billion in nine months.

text.p: Lebanon had a $1.695 billion trade deficit in the third quarter, bringing the deficit for the first nine months of 1996 to $4.716 billion, Banque Audi said in its latest economic report.
The total was 2.8 percent down on the same period of 1995, the report issued on Tuesday said.
Third-quarter imports rose 18 percent over the second quarter to $1.988 billion, bringing the year-to-date total to $5.458 billion, a 0.5 percent increase on the first nine months of 1995.
Third-quarter exports rose 30.8 percent on the second quarter to $293 million, bringing the total for the first nine months to $742 million, a 27.9 percent increase on the same period of 1995.
